news.headline: Funding Follows Impact. Impact Starts With Awareness.
Your Community Is Online. That Doesn't Mean Your Message Is Getting Through.
People Can't Use Resources They Don't Know Exist
Stop Reacting, Start Connecting: Communication Has Become Housing’s Hot-Button Issue
Tribal Housing Has a Communication Crisis That's Not Being Talked About

paragraphs: Patter COMPASS sells a branded mobile communication platform to community organizations, and the homepage states that it is built for CBOs, Housing, and Nonprofits. The site describes three connected components, the COMPASS App, the COMPASS Network, and COMPASS Analytics, which together combine communication, resources, and engagement tools into one app. Listed features include a custom-branded app, instant push notifications, a digital resource hub, smart member segments, a news feed, and an analytics dashboard.

COMPASS is described as designed for organizations that need a reliable way to reach communities, with audiences listed as workforce and training providers, housing organizations, and community-based nonprofits serving local areas. One post addresses housing authority leaders and CBO directors about whether mobile belongs in the communication strategy.

Another post says the Homes4Good name was retired and the work brought under a single brand at a conference session on resident outreach. The COMPASS Network is described as extending reach beyond the organization by connecting with partners so opportunities, resources, and information can flow across communities.

quote.text: Patter COMPASS helps CBOs communicate with the communities they serve clearly, securely, and efficiently.
